work_items.title: Foundation — status->sheet mapping, pure smooth-marker interpolation, i18n deltas
acceptance_criteria: headlineRules.ts still produces a headline key per status AND now exposes the sheet-content descriptor the map-first sheet needs: a stable discriminant per status (searching | assigned | arrived | inProgress | completed | cancelled) so TrackingSheet renders the right block. Reuse the existing HeadlineDescriptor flags (showCancel/showAcceptedHint/showRating/showVehicle/showDropoff/showCall); add a `phase` (or equivalent) discriminant field rather than duplicating the switch in the component. Both New AND Assigned collapse to the 'searching' phase and BOTH use the 'customer.tracking.headline.new' heading key ('Hledame ridice...') per spec section 2 ('Looking for drivers...' for New/Assigned) — this CHANGES Assigned's heading from the current assignedNoEta so the searching loader is never paired with a 'Ridic je na ceste' heading. Accepted -> 'assigned' phase (keeps assignedEta/assignedNoEta). Unknown status keeps the safe 'searching' default with cancel blocked.

markerInterpolation.ts is a PURE module (imports nothing from leaflet/react): given a previous coord, a next coord, elapsed ms and a duration ms it returns the linearly-interpolated coord; elapsed>=duration returns exactly `next`; elapsed<=0 returns `prev`; a null/absent prev returns `next` (first fix snaps, no animation from nowhere). It exposes a reduced-motion decision (a pure `shouldAnimate(prefersReducedMotion)` or an `interpolate` that, when reduced-motion is passed, returns `next` immediately) so the caller honors prefers-reduced-motion without touching the DOM here.

All NEW i18n keys are added to ALL SIX locale JSONs (cs-CZ, en-US, ru-RU, uk-UA, fil-PH, de-DE) in customer formal 'vy' tone; locales.parity.test.ts and formatStaysCs.test.ts stay green. Only ADD deltas — do NOT re-declare keys that already exist (customer.tracking.headline.*, customer.loader.searching, customer.tracking.vehicleLabel/dropoffLabel/cancel/ratingSeam/pushPrompt* etc. are already present). Likely deltas: a Cancelled-state re-order CTA (e.g. customer.tracking.reorder), any new sheet section titles/bodies (arrived/in-progress/completed ride-summary labels) not already covered, and a sheet aria-label key. Money stays cs-CZ/Kc and dates Europe/Prague in every locale.
test_cases: deriveHeadline (extend headlineRules.test.ts): New and Assigned -> 'searching' phase, key 'customer.tracking.headline.new', showCancel true (Assigned's heading is now headline.new, NOT assignedNoEta); Accepted -> 'assigned', assignedEta/assignedNoEta key, showAcceptedHint true; Arrived -> 'arrived' showVehicle; InProgress -> 'inProgress' showDropoff; Completed -> 'completed' showRating (price and no-price variants); Cancelled -> 'cancelled' showCall + showCancel false; unknown status -> safe 'searching' default, cancel blocked.

markerInterpolation (fake timers not required — pure math, but a fake-timer test drives an example tick sequence): midpoint elapsed returns the lat/lng midpoint; elapsed>=duration returns next exactly; elapsed<=0 returns prev; null prev returns next; reduced-motion path returns next immediately (no interpolation).
i18n parity across all 6 locales stays green; formatStaysCs stays green.
work_items.notes: This is an EXTENSION of headlineRules, not a rewrite — its existing keys + flags are consumed by RatingForm/CancelDialog and the e2e headline assertions (e.g. 'Hledame ridice...', 'Rid...je na ceste', 'Objednavka byla zrusena', /Hotovo/). Do not rename or drop those keys or e2e/customer.spec.ts REDs. Keep TrackVm unchanged (WI-2/3/4 build on it). markerInterpolation is the NEW smooth-movement math; the per-frame rAF tick is NOT here (it lives in the lazy map component in WI-3) so this module stays pure and eager-safe like mapCamera.ts/markerThrottle.ts. selectCarMarker is already pure and unit-tested; reuse it as-is (no change needed here).

work_items.title: Status-driven tracking bottom sheet (searching/assigned/arrived/in-progress/completed/cancelled + cancel + rating)
acceptance_criteria: EVERY phase renders the descriptor headline (t(descriptor.key, values)) as a heading-role element (preserve StatusHeadline's <h2> semantics with aria-live polite) — this is a LOAD-BEARING contract: e2e/customer.spec.ts locates status via getByRole('heading', { name }) with the EXACT strings 'Hledame ridice...' (New/Assigned, U+2026 ellipsis, from headline.new), /Ridic.*je na ceste/ (Accepted), 'Objednavka byla zrusena' (Cancelled), /Hotovo/ (Completed). The SearchingLoader is the animated adornment shown ALONGSIDE the heading in the searching phase (role=status, text 'Hledam ridice...' from customer.loader.searching) — it does NOT replace the heading.

TrackingSheet renders inside the shared BottomSheet (role=dialog, i18n aria-label, Escape closes/collapses, focus moves in on open) and switches its content on the WI-1 sheet phase: searching -> heading 'Hledame ridice...' + SearchingLoader adornment + Cancel button; assigned -> heading + driver first name + vehicle (plate/color) + ETA line ('Ridic ... prijede za ~X min', ETA omitted gracefully when null) + Cancel button; arrived -> 'Ridic je na miste' heading + vehicle; inProgress -> 'Jedete' heading + destination; completed -> heading (price via money.ts) + ride summary (addresses) + rating slot; cancelled -> 'Objednavka byla zrusena' heading + a 'back to /customer to re-order' CTA.

Cancel is offered ONLY when the descriptor allows it (showCancel: New/Assigned/Accepted) and only when an orderId is present (public mode has no id -> no cancel button). Clicking Cancel opens CancelDialog (reuse as-is: showAcceptedHint, isPending, errorKey, onConfirm/onDismiss); the sheet is a controlled presentational surface — it calls back to the page (onRequestCancel) and receives cancel state + dialog visibility as props, OR owns the CancelDialog locally driven by injected useCancelOrder result props. Do not duplicate the cancel mutation here — reuse useCancelOrder through props from the page.

Rating is authed-only: the completed state renders the injected ratingSlot (RatingForm) when provided; when absent (public mode) it shows the default ratingSeam text. Reuse RatingForm/StarPicker/useRateOrder unchanged (mounted by the page only on completed).

Presentational contract: the sheet receives a normalized view-model (TrackVm + descriptor + orderId + cancel state + optional ratingSlot) and callbacks; it holds only local UI state (dialog open, options expand). No api-client import, no data fetching in the sheet.

Accessibility: all interactive controls >=48px (theme.touchTargets.min); Cancel/re-order are real <button>/<a>; aria-live polite on the status headline; axe clean; sheet expanded/collapsed height keeps the map + bottom-left Mapy logo reachable (BottomSheet already insets).
test_cases: TrackingSheet (Czech default, mock nothing network — pure props): searching phase renders a heading-role 'Hledame ridice...' (getByRole('heading', { name: 'Hledame ridice...' }) — the exact e2e string) AND the SearchingLoader role=status adornment AND Cancel; assigned renders a heading matching /Ridic.*je na ceste/ (or the ETA variant) + driver+vehicle and Cancel; assigned with null ETA omits the ~min line without error; arrived heading 'Ridic je na miste'; inProgress heading 'Jedete' + destination; completed heading /Hotovo/ with cs-CZ Kc grouping + rating slot; cancelled heading 'Objednavka byla zrusena' + re-order CTA. Assert each via getByRole('heading', { name }) using the same strings the e2e uses so WI-4's e2e cannot RED on a missing heading.
Cancel button appears only when showCancel && orderId present; absent in public/no-id and in Arrived/InProgress/Completed/Cancelled.

Clicking Cancel surfaces CancelDialog (post-Accepted hint when showAcceptedHint); confirm/dismiss callbacks fire; a stale-close is avoided (dialog stays open on failure) per the existing TrackingPage pattern.
Completed with an injected ratingSlot renders the RatingForm; without it renders the ratingSeam default.
Escape closes the sheet; primary controls are >=48px; Axe: no violations.
work_items.notes: TrackingSheet SUPERSEDES StatusHeadline's role as the presentation surface (StatusHeadline + the old TrackingPage layout are removed in WI-4). Reuse StatusHeadline's cs-CZ price-grouping approach (Intl.NumberFormat('cs-CZ')) via money.ts formatCzk so the ' Kc' suffix stays in the i18n template. Public token-poll mode MUST render the SAME sheet UI (AC#5) — the sheet is mode-agnostic: it only sees a TrackVm, so the page (WI-4) builds an identical VM from either useTrackingAuthed or useTrackingPublic. Do NOT put a mini-map inside the sheet — the map is the full-bleed shell background (WI-3). Reuse SearchingLoader (already ships prefers-reduced-motion). Keep CancelDialog/RatingForm/StarPicker unchanged.

work_items.title: Live driver marker + camera follow + smooth interpolation on the full-bleed shell map
acceptance_criteria: CustomerMapShell + CustomerMapBackground accept NEW optional DATA props carMarker: LatLng | null and pickupMarker: LatLng | null (plain coordinates, mirroring how cameraTarget is a plain LatLng[] data prop). The <Marker> elements and their divIcons are constructed INSIDE CustomerMapBackground (the sole leaflet importer under the shell) — the page never imports react-leaflet/leaflet. Move TrackingMapInner's PICKUP_ICON and CAR_ICON here and KEEP the exact className 'tracking-car-icon' (and pickup className) — customer.spec.ts locates '.tracking-car-icon'. Existing cameraTarget/onCenterChange behavior and the center-pin (order flow) are UNCHANGED and still tested green.

The car marker moves SMOOTHLY between discrete position updates: an animated-marker component inside the lazy chunk consumes the raw carMarker target and animates its rendered position frame-by-frame via markerInterpolation (WI-1) using requestAnimationFrame, holding the interpolated position in LOCAL component state. It does NOT thread the interpolated position back up through the shell (no per-frame shell re-render — rules/web-performance.md#high-frequency-events). On a new target it interpolates from the current rendered position to the new target over ~the update interval; the first fix snaps (no prev).

prefers-reduced-motion is honored: when reduced motion is preferred (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)')), the marker jumps directly to each new target (no rAF animation) via markerInterpolation's reduced-motion path.

Camera: when carMarker + pickupMarker are both present the shell drives a fitBounds over [car, pickup] via the existing cameraTarget/CameraController (the page passes those points); with only one point setView is used (existing behavior). No new camera math — reuse mapCamera.cameraIntent through cameraTarget; the page (WI-4) composes the points.

Leaflet stays out of eager chunks (verified: CustomerMapBackground remains the only shell leaflet importer; build/size gate green in WI-4). Map region keeps its i18n aria-label; markers have i18n titles (customer.tracking.carLabel/pickupLabel already exist).
test_cases: CustomerMapBackground (mock react-leaflet Marker + MapContainer + useMap/useMapEvents + useGeoConfig + leafletSetup, per the existing test's precedent): passing carMarker renders a car Marker (assert the icon className / testid); passing pickupMarker renders a pickup Marker; null carMarker renders no car marker; cameraTarget/onCenterChange/center-pin existing tests still pass.

Smooth interpolation (vi.useFakeTimers + a fake requestAnimationFrame or advancing timers): after a new carMarker target, the rendered marker position advances toward the target over successive frames and reaches it (assert intermediate != target then final == target). Never mount a real MapContainer.
prefers-reduced-motion (mock matchMedia -> reduce): a new carMarker target updates the rendered position immediately with no intermediate frames.
CustomerMapShell: carMarker/pickupMarker/cameraTarget thread through to CustomerMapBackground; exactly-once ensureFleetSlug/enableSilentRefresh preserved (existing tests stay green).
Axe: no violations on the background with markers wired.
work_items.notes: SANCTIONED shell extension — UC-014's CustomerMapShell/Background doc comments say the slots/map are 'filled by UC-015/016'; UC-015 added cameraTarget/onCenterChange, UC-016 adds carMarker/pickupMarker by the SAME data-prop discipline. CRITICAL (advisor + CLAUDE.md leaflet-lazy note): do NOT add a `<Marker>`-children/ReactNode map prop — the page would then import react-leaflet and leak leaflet into the eager customer chunk, failing AC#7 + the size budget at build time. Pass coordinates only; render markers inside the lazy chunk. Keep '.tracking-car-icon' className verbatim (e2e locator). rAF tick + local state only — no useMemo/useCallback without a measured re-render problem (rules/web-performance.md#memoization-policy). In jsdom tests, mock react-leaflet's Marker (never a real MapContainer). markerThrottle from the board is a reference but the customer tracks ONE driver, so throttling is less critical than smooth interpolation.

work_items.title: Map-first TrackingPage assembly (authed+public, same UI) + router sibling + remove old presentation + tracking e2e
acceptance_criteria: TrackingPage is rewritten as the map-first screen: it composes CustomerMapShell (full-bleed map background) with bottomSlot=TrackingSheet, threading carMarker/pickupMarker (from selectCarMarker + pickup) and cameraTarget (fitBounds over [car, pickup] when both known, else setView) into the shell. It keeps the /customer/t/:code route (authed + ?k=token public modes) and reuses trackingMode/useTrackingAuthed/useTrackingPublic unchanged.

Mode parity (AC#5): the page builds ONE normalized TrackVm + orderId + carMarker + pickupMarker from EITHER useTrackingAuthed (SignalR live position via usePositionStore/selectCarMarker) OR useTrackingPublic (DTO last-known position), and feeds the SAME TrackingSheet + same shell — public and authed render identical map-first UI. Public mode degrades gracefully where live data is absent (ETA null -> ETA line omitted; no cancel/rating since there is no id/authed customer). Public 410 still shows the expired state ('Odkaz vyprsel') + call fallback; 'none' mode still shows the login-needed prompt.

Cancel + rating are wired through the page: useCancelOrder(orderId) result + CancelDialog visibility state passed to TrackingSheet; RatingForm mounted (authed only) into the completed rating slot. Reuse the existing stale-close-avoidance pattern (branch on the returned outcome, not the captured errorKey).

Router: /customer/t/:code is moved to a SIBLING leaf of the CustomerLayout group (mirroring MapOrderPage / /customer/login) so it owns the full-viewport shell and re-runs the one-shot slug/silent-refresh initializers itself; the OLD nested t/:code child under CustomerLayout is REMOVED (no ambiguous double match). /customer/history stays under CustomerLayout. Verify the logged-out public link still never redirects to /customer/login (public/track is AllowAnonymous 410/404; pin with a public-mode test).

Old presentation removed with colocated tests: StatusHeadline, TrackingMap, TrackingMapInner (and TrackingMap.test). Reused logic/hooks KEPT: headlineRules, markerInterpolation, trackingMode, trackingMarker/selectCarMarker, useTrackingAuthed, useTrackingPublic, useCancelOrder, useRateOrder, RatingForm, StarPicker, CancelDialog, PushPrompt, ratingRules. PushPrompt still mounted. No dangling imports (tsc green).

The tracking e2e (customer.spec.ts AC#2/#3/#5/#7) is updated to the map-first UI: the '.tracking-car-icon' marker locator still resolves (WI-3 kept the className), headline assertions ('Hledame ridice...', /Rid.*je na ceste/, 'Objednavka byla zrusena', /Hotovo/, 'Odkaz vyprsel') still pass against the sheet, and the CancelDialog flow ('Zrusit objednavku' -> dialog 'Zrusit objednavku?' -> 'Ano, zrusit') still works. cs-CZ; reuse the existing SMS-hash injection + apiDriver/apiCustomer helpers.
Quality gates green (conductor runs pre-commit): tsc, lint (0 warnings), vitest, build, size, e2e; leaflet stays in lazy chunks (size gate).
test_cases: TrackingPage (mock @/shared/api/client + react-leaflet + useGeoConfig + leafletSetup + useFleetHub/usePositionStore): authed New -> searching sheet + Cancel; simulate OrderChanged->Accepted (patch/refetch) -> assigned sheet live; a live position in usePositionStore renders the car marker via the shell; Cancelled -> cancelled sheet + re-order CTA.

TrackingPage public mode (mock getPublicTrack): renders the SAME searching/assigned sheet from the DTO; ETA null omitted; no cancel/rating; 410 -> expired state + call; token-poll stops on 410 (useTrackingPublic behavior).
TrackingPage cancel flow: Cancel -> CancelDialog -> confirm -> cancelled sheet; failure keeps the dialog open (stale-close avoidance).
Axe on the assembled tracking screen (searching + assigned states).
Full customer vitest suite green after removals (no broken imports; tsc green).

e2e customer.spec.ts: AC#2 live headline flip + car marker (best-effort marker, authoritative headline), AC#3 valid vs expired public link, AC#5 cancel-in-Accepted, AC#7 rating server-side — all pass on the map-first UI.
work_items.notes: tsc is the primary automated gate because it catches dangling imports from removing StatusHeadline/TrackingMap/TrackingMapInner. Playwright is justified: tracking is a critical customer flow and the e2e already exists (update, don't add a new spec). CRITICAL removal-order: move the sibling route + rewrite TrackingPage BEFORE deleting StatusHeadline/TrackingMap so the app never references a deleted module. The public link must keep working under CustomerMapShell (which calls enableSilentRefresh('/customer/login')): public/track is AllowAnonymous (410/404, never 401), so silent-refresh-on-401 never fires — pin it with the public-mode test. Do NOT reintroduce a collapsible mini-map (TrackingMap/TrackingMapInner are the OLD presentation being replaced by the full-bleed shell map). Reuse selectCarMarker for the marker source in both modes (authed: live store wins; public: DTO position). Keep the e2e's '.tracking-car-icon' contract.
